swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): New discoveries can change our understanding of the world. Reason (R): A puzzle piece found in the wrong place is moved. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): New discoveries can change our understanding of the world, the way a wrongly placed jigsaw piece is moved once the mistake is noticed. Reason (R): This is because, as the chapter explains, science is rarely done alone, and scientists across the world often work together in large teams. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
